etymologies.etymologyHTML: From spoke (“past participle of speak”) +‎ -s- +‎ woman.

definitions.definition: A woman who speaks as the voice of a group of people.

quote.citation: 2009 January 28, Brooks Barnes, “Sweet Deal to Promote Tweeny-Bop Girl Group”, in The New York Times‎[1]:
quote.text: Topps […]  has signed the Clique Girlz as commercial spokeswomen for Baby Bottle Pop, one of the Top 10 nonchocolate candy brands.

quote.citation: 2020 July 1, Richard Clinnick, “Network News: '165' runs through points and into path of LU service”, in Rail, page 20:
quote.text: A Chiltern spokeswoman told RAIL: "We have an excellent safety record and are working with the Rail Accident Investigation Branch to understand the causes of this incident."
